title: CI-PINN: Causal Integral Physics-Informed Neural Network for Solving Evolution Equations
summary: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) solve partial differential equations (PDEs) by incorporating governing physical laws into the training loss. For evolution equations, however, their conventional pointwise space--time representation does not explicitly encode temporal dependence, which can hinder accurate prediction. To mitigate this limitation, this work proposes a novel neural architecture termed a causal integral neural network (CinNet).
